retry_load_images: load a list of images from file paths with automatic retry on failure using cv2 or pytorch backend
get_sequence: generate a list of sampled frame indices centered around a given index with a specified sample rate
spatial_sampling: perform spatial sampling on video frames with random scale jitter, crop, and horizontal flip augmentation
tensor_normalize: normalize a pytorch tensor by subtracting mean and dividing by std with uint8 to float conversion
load_image_lists: load image paths and labels from a frame list file into a dict or list structure
